title: Qwen Image Edit: masked inpainting
summary: Edit part of an image with Qwen Image Edit: paint a mask, soften its edge, repaint only that region.

steps.title: The image to edit
steps.body: Loads the picture you want to change. This one was painted with a mask in ComfyUI's mask editor (right-click the image, Open in MaskEditor).

steps.title: The mask
steps.body: A second image whose red channel is used as the mask: white means repaint, black means keep. Here the mask comes from a separate file.
steps.tryIt: Swap in a different mask image.

steps.title: Soften the mask edge
steps.body: A hard-edged mask leaves a visible seam. The blur radius (31.3 here) feathers the edge so the repaint blends into its surroundings.
steps.tryIt: Lower blur_radius to 0 and look for a seam.

steps.title: Match mask to image
steps.body: The mask is resized to the same size as the image so each mask pixel lines up with an image pixel.

steps.title: Image to latent
steps.body: Compresses the image into the latent space the model works in.

steps.title: Apply the mask
steps.body: Attaches the mask to the latent so the sampler only changes the masked region.
steps.tryIt: Follow the two incoming wires: the latent and the mask.

steps.title: The edit model
steps.body: qwen-image-edit-2511 as a Q4_K_M GGUF: a quantized version that needs less VRAM.

steps.title: Lightning LoRA for edits
steps.body: The Lightning-4steps LoRA for the edit model lets this workflow finish in 4 steps.
steps.tryIt: Bypass it to see the difference.

steps.title: Sampling shift
steps.body: A setting for this model family that changes how the sampling schedule is spread. This workflow uses 3.1.
steps.tryIt: Leave it unless you are tuning.

steps.title: Tell it what to change
steps.body: The edit instruction goes here (this workflow has 'Make a gold face'). The node also looks at the image and the VAE so the model sees what it is editing.
steps.tryIt: Write your own instruction, Queue, and compare.

steps.title: The sampler
steps.body: 4 steps, cfg 1, euler, simple. These match the Lightning LoRA.
steps.tryIt: Change the seed to get another variation.

steps.title: Before and after
steps.body: A slider that overlays the original and the edited result so you can see exactly what changed.

steps.title: Your result
steps.tryIt: Queue and check the mask edges.

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: Queue Prompt sends the whole workflow to the GPU. Nodes light up as they run, and results appear in the Save node.
steps.tryIt: Press Ctrl+Enter, or the Queue button in the highlighted area.
